title: Periodic Analogs of Multiple Black Holes Solutions
summary: In this article, we extend the numerical studies developed in [arXiv:2210.12898] to construct periodic stationary axisymmetric solutions containing multiple horizons in each fundamental domain. As a direct application, we consider periodic stationary axisymmetric solutions with two identical equidistant counter-rotating horizons. These solutions can be parametrized by the period $L$, the mass $M$, and the absolute value of the angular momentum $|J| >0$.
